how_to_apply: Visit the official UPSSSC website, upsssc.gov.in, and go to the Live Advertisement Segment on the homepage to find and view the relevant advertisement.
Log in using your PET-2025 registration number and verify via the OTP sent to your registered mobile number or email.
Your personal details from PET-2025 (name, parentage, category, EWS status, horizontal reservation, date of birth, gender, marital status, contact details) will be auto-filled.
Fill in the mandatory educational qualification details, including board/institution name, year of passing, certificate number, and marks.
Enter the verification code and submit the registration; note your 11-digit registration number from the generated application form.
Review your auto-displayed PET-2025 photo and signature (these cannot be changed) and continue.
Select any preferential qualification, if applicable, and confirm your address details.
Read and accept the declaration, enter the verification code, and click Save and Submit.
Pay the application fee online via Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Challan.
Download and print your final submitted application form for your records.
important_instructions: Candidates must possess the mandatory educational qualification and satisfy the age limit as on the last date of application, 7 October 2026. Applications cannot be submitted or fees paid after 7 October 2026; no representation or claim will be entertained after this date. The application form can only be modified up to 14 October 2026, and only for the specific fields UPSSSC permits (correspondence address, EWS/horizontal reservation category, qualification details, marital status). No other fields can be changed after modification. Candidates claiming EWS reservation must hold an EWS certificate issued between 1 April 2026 and 7 October 2026, based on financial year 2025-26 income, valid for financial year 2026-27. Persons with disabilities must hold a disability certificate in the prescribed format from UP Government's Divyangjan Sashaktikaran Anubhag-3, clearly stating the category and percentage of disability. Women candidates' category will be determined based on their father's caste certificate only. Candidates already employed in Central or State Government service must obtain a No Objection Certificate from their employer for participating in this selection process. UPSSSC does not correspond individually with candidates; all information is published on the official website, which candidates should check regularly. Furnishing incorrect information, or being found ineligible at any stage even after conditional admission to the exam, will lead to rejection of candidature and can result in debarment from this and future UPSSSC exams. Only the last submitted application is accepted if a candidate applies more than once.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Avar Abhiyanta (Krishi) Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: UPSSSC has notified a total of 134 vacancies for the Avar Abhiyanta (Junior Engineer) post under the Directorate of Agriculture. The notification clarifies that the number of vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease. The post carries Pay Level-6 with a pay band of ₹9,300 – ₹34,800 and Grade Pay ₹4,200, and the vacancies are a mix of permanent and temporary positions. In addition to the category-wise breakup above, horizontal reservation applies within the 134 posts as follows: Persons with Hearing Disability (H.H.) - 2; Persons with Locomotor Disability/Dwarfism/Acid Attack Victims (O.A., O.L., L.C., Dw., A.A.V.) - 3; Ex-Servicemen/Dependents of Military Personnel - 6; Women - 26; Outstanding Sportspersons - 2. No vacancies are notified under Dependants of Freedom Fighters or Blindness/Low Vision categories for this post.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Avar Abhiyanta (Krishi) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for UPSSSC Avar Abhiyanta (Krishi) Recruitment 2026 has two parts: eligibility to apply for this Main Exam, and the underlying educational qualification for the post itself. Only candidates who appeared in the Preliminary Eligibility Test 2025 (PET-2025) and hold a valid PET-2025 score card issued by UPSSSC are eligible to apply. Shortlisting for the Main Exam is done post-wise, based on the normalized PET-2025 score, up to 15 times the number of advertised posts (including all candidates tied at the final cutoff score, calculated to two decimal places). Candidates whose absolute or normalized PET-2025 score is zero or negative will not be shortlisted for the Main Exam. As per the Uttar Pradesh Agriculture Department Avar Abhiyanta Seva Niyamawali, 2015 (Part-4, Rule-8), candidates must hold: A High School certificate from the UP Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, or an equivalent examination recognized by the Government; and A three-year Diploma in Agricultural Engineering from the Prāvidhik Shiksha Parishad, Uttar Pradesh, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government and approved by AICTE. Candidates should assess their qualification as on the last date of application, 7 October 2026, and must possess the required certificates by that date. As per Rule-9 of the same service rules, other things being equal, preference in direct recruitment is given to candidates who have either served a minimum of two years in the Territorial Army, or obtained the National Cadet Corps (NCC) 'B' certificate.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Avar Abhiyanta (Krishi) Age Limit
content_sections.text: As per Rule-10 of the UP Krishi Vibhag Avar Abhiyanta Seva Niyamawali, 2015 (Part-4), a candidate must have attained 18 years of age and must not have exceeded 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year in which the vacancies are advertised for direct recruitment. Age relaxation is admissible to SC, ST, and other government-notified categories as per prevailing rules. Government servants in UP state service get a 5-year relaxation in the upper age limit as per the applicable government order. Age is calculated based on the date of birth recorded in the High School or equivalent certificate; no other document is accepted for date of birth verification. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.text: Selection for UPSSSC Avar Abhiyanta (Krishi) Recruitment 2026 follows this process: Preliminary Eligibility Test 2025 (PET-2025) - already conducted; used only as a shortlisting tool for this Main Exam. Shortlisting for the Main Exam based on category-wise normalized PET-2025 score, up to 15 times the number of advertised posts.
